quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别开头第一句直接给出的主旨

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在听力开头快速锁定主题句，避免被后续分点细节带偏。

major_issues: Existing flip card asks for a one-sentence summary but hides the checkable answer on the back.
The front does not force the learner to distinguish the first topic sentence from the following detail-preview sentence.
No quality_metadata is present, so source/audio and review status are not explicit.
minor_issues: Audio file quality is not formally reviewed; current review only covers text/task design.
cards.recommendation: Rewrite as an auto-scored multiple_choice card that tests the opening topic sentence.

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 用 central role 信号概括开头主题

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户从开头总述句中提炼完整主题，而不是被例证细节或相邻话题干扰。

major_issues: Existing multiple_choice direction is usable, but the analysis is template-heavy and does not teach central role as the topic signal.
The card lacks quality_metadata, leaving simulated source and TTS boundaries implicit.
Distractor rationale should separate theme coverage from detail-only or unrelated options.
minor_issues: Keep the core answer direction but rewrite prompt, analysis, options, and metadata for sample review.
cards.recommendation: Retain the transcript and main answer, but make the opening-topic rule explicit.

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 过滤寒暄并识别 focus on 后的开头主题

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在讲座或说明类听力中抓住议程宣告句，稳定定位主旨。

major_issues: Existing timing-click task is downcast to flip, so the front promises click behavior that is not exposed by the product contract here.
The answer-window back side cannot serve as a self-contained front-side learning task.
The card should test the theme announced after Today we will focus on rather than unreviewed timing-window behavior.
minor_issues: Original time_window_ms is unsuitable for this candidate sample branch because audio timing has not been formally reviewed.
cards.recommendation: Rewrite as multiple_choice to filter greeting language and select the announced theme.

batch_review.box_progression: The existing first three cards do not yet form a clean recognition -> application -> transfer progression for 开头点题.
repetition_or_gap_risks: Two cards depend on back-side or timing-window answer revelation rather than front-side solvable choices.
Source and TTS status are not explicit in quality_metadata.
batch_review.next_step: Revise only the first three cards as a candidate sample and keep it out of approved_batches until explicit user confirmation.
